verification.name: P39 Autonomous Skills and Cinematic Web

safetyInvariants: selected != installed != loaded != configured != authenticated != connected != approved
Auto Initialize bootstraps every materializable skill into the user-owned PC-wide Dockyard library and reuses already-active immutable revisions across projects
approval-required and quarantined packages may be staged but remain inactive and are never injected automatically
discovery-only catalogue entries are never represented as installed
only current request/phase selected ready skill packages with immutable active revisions are eligible for automatic model-context loading
selected installed skill text is re-read through the integrity-verifying active community entrypoint path before injection
selected skill context is bounded by skill count, per-skill characters and total characters; failed verification/read becomes an explicit warning
upstream skill text is scoped guidance and never overrides the user request, Dockyard approval policy, security gates or repository evidence
provider/model credentials are never stored in Dockyard project/checkpoint state
provider/MCP readiness never grants mutation approval
